description: Twelve selected trials: L1-L4 use low noise with both EKFs, H1-H4 use high noise with both EKFs, and O1-O4 use high noise with both EKFs disabled. Each H/O pair has identical noise, controller, sequence and scene settings; estimator settings differ only in the enable switches. PNG/CSV files are copied unchanged. Only entries in runs contribute to the analysis. No source commit was recorded.
